data.q: What must a GST tax invoice show about the supplier?
data.reply: It must show the supplier’s name, address and GSTIN, a consecutive serial number unique for the financial year and the invoice date. It also must include the signature or digital signature of the supplier or an authorised representative.
data.source: CGST Invoice Rules: Tax invoice: Supplier details, serial number and date (https://cbic-gst.gov.in/gst-invoice-rules.html, checked 2026-11-26)
searched: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy
terms: gst, tax, invoice, show, supplier, gstin
Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy
terms: gst, tax, invoice, show, supplier, gstin

retrieved.sourceTitle: CGST Invoice Rules: Tax invoice
retrieved.heading: Supplier details, serial number and date
retrieved.text: A tax invoice issued by a registered person must show the name, address and GSTIN of the supplier, a consecutive serial number unique for the financial year (letters, numerals, hyphen or slash), and the date the invoice was issued.

retrieved.sourceTitle: Acme Travel Pvt Ltd expense policy
retrieved.heading: Supplier GSTIN
retrieved.text: The supplier's GSTIN is required for any expense above ₹2,000.00. A missing or invalid GSTIN is flagged for the approver.

retrieved.sourceTitle: CGST Invoice Rules: Tax invoice
retrieved.heading: Place of supply, reverse charge and signature
retrieved.text: For an inter-State supply the invoice must show the place of supply with the State name, the delivery address if different, whether tax is payable on reverse charge, and the signature or digital signature of the supplier or an authorised representative.

retrieved.sourceTitle: CGST Invoice Rules: Tax invoice
retrieved.heading: Recipient details
retrieved.text: A tax invoice must show the recipient's name, address and GSTIN or UIN if the recipient is registered. If the recipient is unregistered and the taxable value is ₹50,000 or more, it must show the recipient name and address, the delivery address, and the name and code of the State.

answer.reply: It must show the supplier’s name, address and GSTIN, a consecutive serial number unique for the financial year and the invoice date. It also must include the signature or digital signature of the supplier or an authorised representative.
